description: This PHP class, RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor, handles processing events related to employee terminations within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract processor, utilizes traits for employee service interactions, and defines methods to get event type, gather event data, and determine whether to save an event based on employee count thresholds.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of employee termination events, including determining event type, gathering relevant data, and deciding if an event should be saved based on employee count metrics.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the specific type of event this processor handles, in this case, an inactive employee count event.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Collects general registration event data and adds the current count of inactive employees, filtering for past employees only.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether an event should be saved based on the count of past employees, saving only when the count reaches a multiple of a predefined size.
